topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that decode sentence-level or open-vocabulary speech from lip or face video (lip reading, VSR, AVSR; ledger names lip reading/VSR/AVSR/LRS2/LRS3 and sentence-level, continuous or open-vocabulary recognition), classified by the sequence objective their full text names: CTC, attention sequence-to-sequence, hybrid CTC/attention, HMM, transducer. Boundary: isolated-word classification only is excluded; a study counts under every objective its text names (upper bound); reviews count as pattern matches; versions count once.
topics.design_field: full-text regexes ctc, attention_seq2seq, hybrid_ctc_attention, hmm, transducer
topics.metric: visual-only LRS3 WER; GRID WER for the same-corpus comparison
topics.period_split: writer-run full-text count over the 67 unique studies of this population first public before 2016-11 (dates from the arXiv id, the index year, or the ISCA key); plus a wiki-wide scan of all 2,048 pre-2016-05 studies with text

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that decode text, speech or acoustic features from articulator video with a trained network, classified by how temporal context enters the image front end (3D convolution, factorized (2+1)D, 2D CNN plus recurrent layer, TCN, ConvLSTM).

Reused published table: studies that apply a decoder trained only on overt (or attempted overt) speech to silent, mouthed or imagined speech and report the result; any signal; chronology labels in the published table are relative to its own target and are recomputed here against 2016-11.

The same sentence-level VSR population as M06, classified by the use-time information its full text names: an n-gram language model (character or word), a neural language model or LLM rescoring, or an explicit statement that no external language model is used; a grammar, lexicon or dictionary constraint is counted separately for the pre-target period. A study counts under every design its text names (upper bound); M07 is slot-filled for 1% of the wiki, so all counts are pattern match.
topics.design_field: full-text regexes ngram_lm, neural_lm_or_llm, no_external_lm, grammar_or_lexicon
topics.metric: WER with and without the use-time language model

topics.inclusion_rule: Lip-reading or VSR studies whose ledger names optical-camera input and the GRID corpus, classified by the evaluation partition their full text names: an unseen-speaker (speaker-independent, held-out speaker) split, an overlapped-speaker (seen-speaker, speaker-dependent) split, or explicit reuse of the held-out set speakers 1, 2, 20 and 22. Boundary: audio-only GRID work and GRID studies without a recognition or synthesis decoder are excluded; a study counts under every partition its text names; versions count once.
topics.pattern: GRID + optical camera + lip reading/VSR ledger pattern

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that put machine lipreading or silent speech recognition and human lipreaders on the same metric over the same data, classified by who the human readers are (professional or expert readers, hearing-impaired or deaf participants, untrained or lay participants).
topics.metric: human WER against machine WER on the same items
